findings.title: Water held in stock also appears as an outward stream
findings.description: The specific water equation adds water in all dispatched/stored streams and then water stock change. Stored water already contributes to closing minus opening stocks. With 10 kg incoming water entirely retained as closing stock, zero opening stock, zero dispatch and zero evaporation, this equation demands 10=10+10. The preceding general balance in the same rule correctly uses output plus stock change, so the water-specific clause contradicts it.
findings.minimum_correction: Use external water outflows plus net evaporation plus closing-minus-opening water stock exactly once. Internal/stored streams are stock/stage subledger entries, not extra boundary outflows. Align both languages and regenerate projection.
evidence: EN/ZH full moisture_balance rule line418; vr_balance line439; cp_material/cp_residue403–407

findings.title: Internal recovered condensate is subtracted twice from aggregate water balance
findings.description: The whole-plant equation subtracts all captured condensate independently of closing water stocks. Internal condensate recovered into the bath or retained in a tank is not an outward water stream and already enters stock/reuse. A 100 kg fresh water cohort with 20 kg retained captured condensate, 80 kg atmospheric net water and no other water outputs gives the authored formula 100-20-20=60 kg instead of 80 kg. The complete scope makes bath reuse internal (line72) and requires stocks (lines332/345); the equation does not condition condensate subtraction on outward transfer.
findings.minimum_correction: Subtract only captured condensate actually transferred across the declared control volume as a separately identified outgoing stream. Internally recovered/recirculated condensate cancels as an internal transfer; retained condensate enters closing stock exactly once. Apply both languages and regenerate projection.
evidence: Source conservation counterexample in finding; no empirical factor assumed

findings.title: Packaging equality omits separate additions and removals to retained articles
findings.description: The packaging-specific equality is opening+P+I+ER=closing+S+EO+W. P/I/ER are qualified whole-article receipts; the surrounding complete clauses expressly keep independently measured repair material/water changes separate and retain them in full wet closing stock. With opening pallet mass 30 kg, no whole-article receipts, dispatch/returns/waste, and 10 kg new repair material or water retained in the pallet, closing is 40 kg. The specific equality gives 30=40 despite the conserving general physical gate giving 30+10=40. Exact reconciliation against other flow terms cannot remove the required inlet from this subledger.
findings.minimum_correction: Include independently measured, non-overlapping material/water additions on the left and removals on the right, after reconciliation with P/I/ER and S/EO/W; alternatively state an explicit equivalent restricted unchanged-article subledger and companion change balance. Preserve full wet stocks, whole-article origins and gross six legs. Apply both languages and projection.
evidence: Complete EN/ZH packaging-receipt basis defines P/I/ER as whole-article receipts and X changes as distinct; cited exact rule lines.
